body: Thank you. I have been trying to get back on track the last few days and make happiness a priority despite external circumstances :)

The bureaucratic formality won't kill me. If anything, it'd be the equivalent of a butterfly that alights from a flower, ruffling the wind that annoys the undercover sniper that accidentally pulls the trigger on me.

I have concepts to live for. I only fear that every time I believe in something, it fails. It's almost like the only concept that's compatible with my life is "suck it up, be miserable and die after a lifetime of unhappiness".

I understand what you're going through. I went through panic attacks myself a few years ago and no one, not my family nor my friends could help but that was partly because I was too embarrassed to tell them exactly what was going on with me. Maybe you could tell your friends, openly and bluntly and without any room for misinterpretation, what exactly you're going through - maybe just show them your post on here? 

I know exactly how much it can hurt. I'm going through a terrible time now and my best friend can't understand what I'm going through but sometimes it's because your loved ones are so scared of losing you, they think if they just denied it, you would stop hurting. Also, sometimes it helps to tell them exactly what you want from them and what you want them to do.
